extName.message: Bambu Studio MD3 下載接手
extName.description: Extension name in the browser's extension list and on the settings page.

extShortName.description: Short extension name where space is tight.

extDescription.message: 將 3D 模型下載交俾 Bambu Studio MD3，佢會先問過你先下載。
extDescription.description: Extension description in the browser's extension list.

actionTitleOn.message: Bambu Studio MD3 下載接手開咗。㩒一下開設定。
actionTitleOn.description: Toolbar button tooltip while capture is on.

actionTitleOff.message: Bambu Studio MD3 下載接手關咗。㩒一下開設定。
actionTitleOff.description: Toolbar button tooltip while capture is off.

badgeOff.description: Badge on the toolbar button while capture is off. Keep it to four characters or fewer.

menuOpenLink.message: 用 Bambu Studio MD3 開呢條連結
menuOpenLink.description: Context menu item on links to model files.

notifyKeptTitle.message: 瀏覽器繼續處理呢個下載
notifyKeptTitle.description: Notification title when a captured download could not be handed over and the browser continued it.

notifyNotSentTitle.message: 冇交到俾 Bambu Studio MD3
notifyNotSentTitle.description: Notification title when a link from the context menu could not be handed over.

notifyBody.description: Notification text. $1 is the file name, $2 is the reason.

reasonQueued.message: Bambu Studio MD3 收到咗，喺嗰邊揀「開始下載」之前乜都唔會下載。

reasonPauseFailed.message: 瀏覽器唔肯暫停呢個下載，所以由瀏覽器繼續下載。
reasonPauseFailed.description: Reason a download stayed in the browser.

reasonHostMissing.message: 呢個瀏覽器未裝 Bambu Studio MD3 嘅瀏覽器連接。
reasonHostMissing.description: Reason: the native messaging host is not registered.

reasonHostForbidden.message: Bambu Studio MD3 嘅瀏覽器連接唔接受呢個擴充功能。
reasonHostForbidden.description: Reason: the native messaging host does not list this extension ID.

reasonHostExited.message: Bambu Studio MD3 嘅瀏覽器連接未回覆就關咗。
reasonHostExited.description: Reason: the native messaging host exited before replying.

reasonHostError.message: 瀏覽器聯絡唔到 Bambu Studio MD3 嘅瀏覽器連接。
reasonHostError.description: Reason: any other native messaging failure.

reasonHostTimeout.message: Bambu Studio MD3 喺 30 秒內冇回覆。
reasonHostTimeout.description: Reason: no reply before the time limit.

reasonHostReply.message: Bambu Studio MD3 嘅回覆，呢個擴充功能睇唔明。
reasonHostReply.description: Reason: the reply was malformed or named another download.

reasonHostProtocol.message: 呢個擴充功能同 Bambu Studio MD3 用緊唔同版本嘅交接方式，兩樣都要更新。

reasonDeclinedBusy.message: Bambu Studio MD3 忙緊，接唔到呢個下載。
reasonDeclinedBusy.description: Reason: the application declined because it is busy.

reasonDeclinedDisabled.message: Bambu Studio MD3 入面關咗下載接手。
reasonDeclinedDisabled.description: Reason: the application has handoffs turned off.

reasonDeclinedInvalid.message: Bambu Studio MD3 唔接受呢個下載地址。
reasonDeclinedInvalid.description: Reason: the application rejected the address.

reasonDeclinedShuttingDown.description: Reason: the application is shutting down.

reasonDeclinedUnsupported.message: Bambu Studio MD3 開唔到呢類檔案。
reasonDeclinedUnsupported.description: Reason: the application does not open this file type.

reasonDeclinedOther.message: Bambu Studio MD3 冇接手呢個下載。
reasonDeclinedOther.description: Reason: the application declined for a reason this extension does not know.

reasonScheme.message: 淨係網址（http 同 https）先可以交接。
reasonScheme.description: Reason: the address is not http or https.

reasonCredentials.message: 呢個地址包含用戶名稱或者密碼，所以冇交出去。

reasonTooLong.message: 呢個地址太長，交接唔到。
reasonTooLong.description: Reason: the address is longer than 8192 characters.

reasonNotModel.message: 呢條連結唔係 Bambu Studio MD3 開到嘅模型檔案。
reasonNotModel.description: Reason: the link is not a known model file.

optionsHeading.description: Main heading of the settings page.

optionsIntro.message: 呢個瀏覽器開始下載 3D 模型嗰陣，擴充功能會暫停下載，再叫 Bambu Studio MD3 接手。Bambu Studio MD3 要回覆話佢會先問你，瀏覽器先會取消自己嗰份：佢會講明檔案、網站同資料夾，你喺嗰邊揀「開始下載」之前乜都唔會下載。其他回覆、或者冇回覆，瀏覽器都會照下載落去。

sectionConnection.message: 同 Bambu Studio MD3 嘅連接

connectionUnknown.description: Connection status before the first check.

connectionOk.description: Connection status. $1 is the application name, $2 its version.

checkConnection.description: Button that asks the native messaging host to answer.

hostNameLabel.description: Label for the native messaging host name.

copyExtensionId.description: Button that copies the extension ID.

copyFailed.message: 複製唔到。請自己揀起個 ID 再複製。

captureEnabled.message: 將模型下載交俾 Bambu Studio MD3
captureEnabled.description: Switch that turns automatic capture on or off.

captureEnabledHelp.message: 關咗嘅話，所有下載都留喺瀏覽器。連結選單項目照用得。

fileTypesLegend.description: Group label for the file type checkboxes.

fileTypesHelp.message: 圖樣、場景同 G-code 一開始係關咗嘅，因為網站都會為其他程式提供呢啲檔案。
fileTypesHelp.description: Help under the file type checkboxes.

excludedLabel.message: 以下網站嘅下載永遠唔好交接
excludedLabel.description: Label for the excluded sites text box.

excludedHelp.message: 每行一個網站，例如 example.com。行頭寫 *. 就包埋嗰個網站下面所有地址，例如 *.example.com。網頁嘅網站同檔案嘅網站都計。
excludedHelp.description: Help for the excluded sites text box.

excludedInvalid.message: 以下幾行唔係網站，冇儲存：$1
excludedInvalid.description: Error under the excluded sites text box. $1 lists the rejected lines.

saveSites.description: Button that saves the excluded sites.

notifyOnFallback.message: 瀏覽器繼續處理下載嗰陣通知我

languageAuto.description: Language choice that follows the browser's interface language.

languageHelp.message: 瀏覽器介面冇廣東話可以揀，所以喺呢度揀。

recentHelp.message: 最近 25 個決定，淨係儲喺呢個瀏覽器。
recentHelp.description: Help for the recent handoffs list.

recentEmpty.description: Empty state of the recent handoffs list.

clearRecent.description: Button that clears the recent handoffs list.

outcomeQueued.description: Outcome in the recent handoffs list.

outcomeKept.description: Outcome in the recent handoffs list.

outcomeNotSent.description: Outcome in the recent handoffs list.

originLink.description: Marks a handoff that came from the context menu.

saved.description: Status after a setting is saved.
